title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Loan/Lease Payoff Benefit Payment: Desk Systems Reference
content:
**Subject.** The loan payoff benefit is the payment the loan/lease payoff option of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage makes to the loss payee of a vehicle surrendered as a total loss when the payoff its lender or lessor states exceeds the surrender settlement. A coverage without the loan/lease payoff option receives no benefit.

## When the benefit is paid

The loan or lease payoff benefit is not paid until the claim carries a surrender settlement the customer has accepted.

In the same terms: a total-loss claim whose settlement record shows no accepted surrender settlement has no loan or lease payoff benefit to pay.

## Business effect of the payment

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Payment | One claim payment of the loan/lease payoff component on the total-loss claim |
| Payee | The loss payee exactly as named on the coverage (the lender or lessor) |
| Date | Today |
| Deductible | None is taken from this payment |
| Loss paid | The payment raises the net amount paid on the vehicle's claims and shows in the claim's payment history |

## The payment tool

**Tool:** `pay_loan_lease_payoff_8a830e94`

**Capability.** Issues the loan/lease payoff benefit on a total-loss claim to the vehicle's loss payee (the lender or lessor named on the coverage). One call issues one payment.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_number` | The claim number of the total-loss claim the benefit is paid on, read from the claim file | Text identifier |
| `amount` | The loan/lease payoff benefit paid | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

The payee is not a parameter: the payment is always made out to the loss payee as named on the coverage.

**Return.** A receipt with `payment_id` (reference of the new payment), `claim_number`, `payment_component` (always `loan_lease_payoff`), `payee_name` (the loss payee exactly as named on the coverage), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places) and `payment_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying `payment_id` means the payment was issued.
